hook.belief: Habits fail because people lack discipline.
hook.gap: If it is not discipline, what breaks the habit?

scenes.narration: Is discipline really what you lack? You need a smaller plan, because big plans collapse on day three.
scenes.visual_intent: The word discipline is struck out; a tiny checklist card slides in.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A giant wall planner cracks down the middle on day three.

scenes.narration: Most people set a huge goal, so the first missed day feels like failure. [PAUSE 0.6s] But a two minute habit survives a bad day.
scenes.visual_intent: A streak counter breaks, then a smaller one keeps counting.

facts.claim: Smaller habits are easier to keep after a missed day.

scenes.visualMetaphor: A streak counter shatters while a two-minute index card keeps ticking.

scenes.narration: Shrink it until skipping feels silly. Then repeat.
scenes.visual_intent: A timer ring closes; the opening line returns.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A timer ring shrinks to a dot, then closes into a loop arrow.
